description: Send feedback about this MCP server to the makesPDF team: a tool failure you could not explain, an error message or tool description that was wrong or misleading, a capability that is missing, or a concrete suggestion. The summary is the problem in your own words (what you were trying to do, what you tried, what you expected); it must not contain the user's document text, markdown, DSL source or data values, and a specific render is identified by its artifactId instead. Read by the makesPDF team; nobody replies in real time. Free: no credits are used and the user's renders are unaffected.

artifactId.description: Optional UUID of the render artifact this concerns (the `artifactId` returned by a render call or the `X-Artifact-Id` response header).

kind.description: `stuck` — a tool failed and you could not work out why; `bug` — something behaved incorrectly (a misleading error/description counts); `suggestion` — a missing capability or a concrete improvement.

summary.description: The problem in your own words: what you were doing, what you tried, and what you expected. Describe it rather than pasting the user's document text, markdown, DSL or data.

toolName.description: Optional name of the tool this concerns (e.g. `render_template`).

name: report_feedback

feedbackId.description: UUID of the stored feedback row.

recorded.description: Always true; a failed submission is a tool error.

title: Send feedback to makesPDF
